saints.name: St. Jane Frances de Chantal
saints.title: Religious and Foundress
saints.shortBlurb: A widow and mother who, guided by St. Francis de Sales, founded the Order of the Visitation…
biography: Born at Dijon in 1572, Jane Frances Frémyot married the Baron de Chantal and was left a widow with four children when he died in a hunting accident. Placing herself under the spiritual direction of St. Francis de Sales, she embraced a life of prayer and charity while raising her family.

Together with Francis de Sales she founded in 1610 at Annecy the Order of the Visitation of Holy Mary, conceived for women whose health or circumstances barred the harsher monastic orders. She governed and spread the new congregation with wisdom and courage through many trials until her death in 1641.
saints.knownFor: Founding the Visitation Order with St. Francis de Sales.

sources.text: Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), “St. Jane Frances de Chantal”
